info.title: Creator Search Open Collaboration Product
info.description:
This API is used to search the information of products with open collaboration by category, commission rate, and keywords. It will return all products on the TikTok Shop Affiliate Product Marketplace that are in an open collaboration.
Creators can only search for open collaboration within the regions they are registered in the affiliate.

post.description:
This API is used to search the information of products with open collaboration by category, commission rate, and keywords. It will return all products on the TikTok Shop Affiliate Product Marketplace that are in an open collaboration.
Creators can only search for open collaboration within the regions they are registered in the affiliate.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The creator access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 1. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a362dccb8030ea6f98c) to get creator access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Pagination offset determines where you begin to search for. It's empty when raise your first request.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: The value of "page_size" must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 20.

parameters.name: sort_field
parameters.description:
The returned results are sorted by the specified field. 

Possible values:
- commission_rate
- product_sales_price
- commission
- units_sold

Specify the sort order using the `sort_order` parameter.

parameters.name: sort_order
parameters.description:
The sort order for the objects in the response. Default: ASC
Possible values:
- ASC: Ascending order
- DESC: Descending order

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body. Full source table is retained in x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.

title_keywords.description: A list of product keywords for searching. Product titles, or names, are loosely matched. Keywords in the list form a query and the resulting set of matching product names is based on the conjunctive operator `AND` between each keyword. For example, the keyword list `["Men", "Fashion"]` creates a query `"Men" AND "Fashion"` and the resulting set of matching product names contains the loosely matched conjuction of "Men" and "Fashion" such as "Male Fashionable". Maximum length of the list is 20 keywords. Maximum keyword string length is 255 characters.

amount_ge.description: The product price must be greater than this value in order to be included in the search results. The value must be greater than `0`.

amount_lt.description: The product price must be greater than this value in order to be included in the search results. The value must be greater than `0`. No upper bound is set if this property is not included.

sales_price_range.description: Restricts the products in the search results to those with prices greater than or equal to the expressed minimum price and less than the expressed maximum price.

id.description: The category identifier. Note that only first-level categories are supported.

category.description: Restricts the products in the search results to those that are associated with the expressed product category.

rate_ge.description: The commission rate must be greater than this value in order to be included in the search results. The commission rate is expressed in hundredths of a percent. For example, `3587` is a commission rate of `35.87%`. This value must a minimum of `1000`.

rate_lt.description: The commission rate must be less than this value in order to be included in the search results. The commission rate is expressed in hundredths of a percent. For example, `3587` is a commission rate of `35.87%`. This value must a minimum of `1000`.

commission_rate_range.description: The commission rate of the searched product needs to be limited within this range.

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

shop.description: Data and metadata associated with the Seller's TikTok Shop.

has_inventory.description: Set to `true` if there are more than zero units of the product in inventory. Set to `false` if there are zero units in inventory.

units_sold.description: Total number of units sold. Units are indexed to SKU. Note that if the creator has not given permission for precise data sharing, this property will not be present.

sale_region.description: The region where the product is offered for sale.

detail_link.description: The URL for the product's detail page.

minimum_amount.description: The lowest original price of all SKUs of the product.

maximum_amount.description: The highest original price of all SKUs of the product.

original_price.description: The original price of the product.

local_name.description: The name of the product in the category.

is_leaf.description: Set to `true` if this category is a leaf node. Set to `false` if not.

parent_id.description: The category identifier of the parent category.

category_chains.description: A list of categories associated with the product. Maximum length of the list is `3` categories.

rate.description: The commission rate in hundredths of a percent. For example, `3587` is a commission rate of `35.87%`. This value must a minimum of `1000`.  The range of this value is [100, 8000].

commission.description: Metadata and data associated with the commission rates for the product.

minimum_amount.description: The lowest promotion price of all SKUs of this product.

maximum_amount.description: The highest promotion price of all SKUs of this product.

sales_price.description: Metadata and data associated with the sale price of the product

next_page_token.description: An opaque token used to retrieve the next page of a paginated result set.

total_count.description: Total count of products meeting the search criteria expressed in the request body.
